{{Quote|Some rescue, Han."''<br/>''"You should never criticize people who are doing you a favor.|Lando Calrissian and Han Solo|<ref name="Rebellion" />}}
The '''Skirmish on Skip 6''' occurred on [[Skip 6]] when [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] traveled there along with a number of other [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] to rescue [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] from the [[Glottalphib]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Nandreeson]]. Han and his team made his way into the Skip and confronted Nandreeson. Han thought that he had the crimelord outnumbered, when the other smugglers revealed that they were actually working for the Glottalphib. In the resulting firefight, the smugglers [[Kid DXo'ln]] and [[Zeen Afit]], along with some of Nandreeson's Glottalphibs were killed. Calrissian obtained a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] and fired it at the fire-eating [[Watumba bat]]s on the ceiling, who descended and killed all the Glottalphibs present. Han, Lando, Chewbacca then flew to [[Skip 1]] in Nandreeson's ship, along with [[Ana Blue]], who had been waiting to see the outcome of the fight before committing herself.
